The transparent material used to make windows is glass.

Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and diabetes. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health and wellness benefits, including reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, slowing down the aging process, and lowering the risk of chronic diseases.
